get.summary:
GetErpAdjPreview returns totals, excluded count, the V-07 result and a paged head list.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view, or .valuate / .approve / .restore per operation

post.summary:
ExecuteErpAdjOperation executes a previewed ADJ operation (gates G1-G11).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.valuate / .approve / .restore per operation

RunErpAttributeBackfill backfills empty attributes on linked products (dry_run default true).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.update

RunErpBacktest runs a SHADOW batch for a closed period.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

get.summary:
GetErpBacktestReport returns the per-period diff report.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view + finance.cost.erpintegration.export

ListErpBatches lists batches filtered by period/status.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
CreateErpBatch creates a batch for a period (refused if one is in flight).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

get.summary:
GetErpBatch returns a batch with summary, progress and allowed actions.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
AbandonErpBatch moves a batch to FAILED (PG only).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

AckErpWarnings acknowledges validation warnings (audit ERP_WARN_ACK).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.approve

PreviewErpAdjOperation snapshots and previews an ADJ operation (read-only Oracle).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.valuate / .approve / .restore per operation

get.summary:
ListErpCoverage lists coverage lines.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
RunErpCoverage computes mapping/cost coverage.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

get.summary:
ExportErpCoverage exports coverage as xlsx.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.export

post.summary:
CreateCostProductFromDemand creates a Yarn product from a demand line (MB is FailedPrecondition).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.update + existing product-master create

RunErpDerive derives standard costs (G10).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

LoadErpDemand loads ERP demand rows (read-only Oracle).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

LockErpBatch locks the batch (LOCK_BATCH single call).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.lock

get.summary:
ExportErpManualSample exports a stratified manual check sample (>=30 combos).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.export

ListErpOracleCalls returns the Oracle call audit log.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
PushErpBatch pushes the batch to Oracle (flag push_enabled).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.push

get.summary:
PreviewErpPush returns control totals, row count and hash (no Oracle I/O).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.push

post.summary:
ReconErpBatch reconciles against the Oracle adjustment set (read-only).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.trigger

get.summary:
ExportErpRecon exports the recon outcome of a batch as xlsx.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.export

ListErpStdCost lists derived standard cost rows.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
ValidateErpBatch runs pre-push validations.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.validate

get.summary:
GetErpIntegrationConfig returns flags, writer mode and Oracle IF configured (never secrets).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

GetErpItemLinkReport reports duplicate, unlinked and no-fg_type items.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
LinkErpToProduct links an ERP item to a product (V-04/V-06/V-11/V-12; never writes grade codes).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.update

RunErpMasterSync syncs OM_ITEM / OM_GRADE_CODE_1 into replicas (read-only Oracle).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.sync

get.summary:
GetErpCurrencySanity returns currency rate sanity checks for a period.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

GetErpPeriodLock returns the period lock state (used by the orchestrator cron).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

post.summary:
LockErpPeriod locks a period.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.lock

UnlockErpPeriod unlocks a period.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.unlock

get.summary:
GetErpIntegrationSchedule returns the effective schedule and next run.
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.view

put.summary:
UpdateErpIntegrationSchedule edits the settings-row schedule (cron validated server-side).
Permission: finance.cost.erpintegration.update

warningSetHash.description: sha256 hex of the warning set being acknowledged (stale-ack guard).

validationErrors.description: List of validation errors if any.

isSuccess.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

v1BaseResponse.description: BaseResponse is the standard response wrapper for all API responses.

v1ErpAdjHead.description: ErpAdjHead is one ADJ head in a preview.

v1ErpAdjOperation.description: ErpAdjOperation is an Oracle adjustment operation.

expiresAt.title: ISO-8601; preview is unusable after this

v1ErpAdjPreview.description: ErpAdjPreview is a snapshot preview of an ADJ operation.

deltaPct.description: delta_pct is diff / legacy * 100 (Round5); empty when legacy is 0 or NULL.

fail.description: fail is true for an SP* basis line that is not MATCH (FAIL rule).

v1ErpBacktestLine.description: ErpBacktestLine is one backtest comparison line.

v1ErpBacktestReport.description: ErpBacktestReport is the per-period backtest diff report.

v1ErpBatch.description: ErpBatch is one integration run for a period.

v1ErpBatchMode.description: ErpBatchMode distinguishes pushable LIVE batches from SHADOW (never pushed).

v1ErpCoverageLine.description: ErpCoverageLine is one demand line with its coverage result.

v1ErpCoverageStatus.description: ErpCoverageStatus is the coverage result of a demand line.

v1ErpCurrencySanityRow.description: ErpCurrencySanityRow is one currency rate check.

v1ErpDeriveStatus.description: ErpDeriveStatus is the derive result of a std-cost row.

pushEnabled.description: Flags mirror config erp_integration.* (all default false).

v1ErpOracleCall.description: ErpOracleCall is one audited Oracle call.

v1ErpPeriodLock.description: ErpPeriodLock is the lock state of a period.

v1ErpReconStatus.description: ErpReconStatus is the reconciliation result vs the ADJ set.

v1ErpSchedule.description: ErpSchedule is the effective integration schedule.

v1ErpScheduleMode.description:
ErpBatchStatus is the batch lifecycle status.
ErpScheduleMode is how the integration schedule picks its run time.

v1ErpStdCostRow.description: ErpStdCostRow is one derived standard cost row.

v1ErpStdSource.description: ErpStdSource is the origin of a standard cost.

v1ErpV07Result.description: ErpV07Result is the V-07 pre-validation result.

v1PaginationRequest.description: PaginationRequest contains pagination parameters for list requests.

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages.

v1PaginationResponse.description: PaginationResponse contains pagination metadata for list responses.

field.description: The field name that failed validation.

v1ValidationError.description: ValidationError represents a single field validation error.
